rows.details: Government Tool Room and Training Centre (GTTC), Bengaluru
Assistant Professor, Assistant Manager, Assistant Grade-2
Online, with a printout sent by post

content_sections.heading: About GTTC
content_sections.text: The Government Tool Room and Training Centre is located at Rajajinagar Industrial Estate, Bengaluru-560 010. This notice is a direct recruitment to backlog posts reserved for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates, so only candidates of these categories are invited.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 7 vacancies in total: 5 for Scheduled Caste (SC) and 2 for Scheduled Tribe (ST).

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: For Assistant Professor, the notice adds that candidates from industry or profession with a Master's degree in the Engineering/Technology fields named above, whose professional work is significant and can be recognised as equivalent to a Ph.D, and who have 10 years' experience at a senior level comparable to an Assistant Professor, are also eligible. Age is counted on the last date fixed for receiving applications. The limits follow the Government Order dated 29-01-2026. The candidate must be an Indian citizen. A male candidate with more than one living wife, or a woman married to a man who already has a living wife, is not eligible without prior permission from the government. The candidate must be mentally and physically healthy and free from any physical defect likely to affect efficient discharge of duties. The appointing authority reserves full discretion to reject on a medical board report. Persons dismissed by the Central Government, Karnataka Government, other State Governments, Public Service Commissions or universities are not eligible. Persons debarred by such bodies from examinations or appointments, or punished for moral turpitude, are not eligible until the appointing authority reconsiders. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Ph.D degree with first class at Bachelor's or Master's level; Bachelor's degree in Mechanical/Production/Industrial & Production Engineering/Technology; AND Master's degree in Tool Engineering/Machine Design/Mechanical Engineering/Product Design/Machine Design & Robotics/Engineering/Technology
rows.experience: 10 years in (a) teaching, of which 5 years at Assistant Professor level and/or equivalent, or (b) industry, or (c) research work

rows.qualification: Degree in Mechanical Engineering/Production Engineering, Post Graduation in Tooling being preferred; proficiency in computers as determined from time to time through GTTC Office Order (direct recruitment)
rows.experience: Minimum 5 years in a reputed Tool Room or Press Shop or Plastic Moulding Shop or Die Casting foundry

rows.qualification: Degree in Arts/Commerce/Science/DBM, or Diploma in Secretarial Practice/Commercial Practice/Modern Office Practice (except Security); proficiency in computers as determined through GTTC Office Order (direct recruitment)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice prints no allowances. The posts are backlog posts for SC and ST candidates, identified as available on 22-11-2001, the date the Karnataka State Civil Services (Unfilled Vacancies Reserved for the persons belonging to the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes) (Special Recruitment) Rules, 2001 came into force. Under Rule 6 of those rules, candidates aged 18 to 29 years form one group and those above 29 years up to the maximum age form another, and recruitment follows the procedure in that rule.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is Rs.500 for each application, paid online along with the application. A candidate applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post and pay the fee for each application. Fee paid is not refunded for any reason.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GTTC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit the application online in the prescribed format on the GTTC website, https://gttc.karnataka.gov.in . Pay the Rs.500 fee online with each application. Attach copies of qualification, experience and caste certificates with the application. Complete the online submission by 5:30 PM on 11 December 2026. After applying online, send a printout of the application with copies of the enclosed documents to: The Managing Director, Government Tool Room and Training Centre, Rajajinagar Industrial Estate, Bengaluru-560 010. Applicants should write their full name, the post applied for and their postal address in the application, as GTTC does not correspond with candidates; a change of address is to be reported only in writing. For more information, the Centre's information office telephone number is 080-23384303.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Qualification certificates Experience certificates Caste certificate from the competent authority in the government-prescribed format (Form D, as given on page 5 of the notice) Printout of the online application The SC/ST certificate must be valid and obtained by the last date; the original is to be produced at document verification.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applying online gives no right to appointment; recruitment is subject to the qualification norms prescribed or that may be prescribed by GTTC. A candidate who impersonates, submits false or altered documents, gives false statements, suppresses facts or uses improper means can have candidature cancelled. GTTC does not accept responsibility for matters relating to address changes beyond a written request. Where the rules differ or are unclear, the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, the Karnataka Civil Services (Direct Recruitment) (General) Rules, 2021 and the GTTC (Cadre, Recruitment and Certain Service Conditions) Rules, 2000 apply.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GTTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 1 Assistant Professor, 3 Assistant Manager and 3 Assistant Grade-2, with 5 reserved for SC and 2 for ST.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GTTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 11 December 2026, by 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GTTC Assistant Manager?
faq.answer: A degree in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering, with Post Graduation in Tooling preferred, computer proficiency and a minimum of 5 years' experience in a reputed Tool Room, Press Shop, Plastic Moulding Shop or Die Casting foundry.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GTTC posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor: minimum 21, maximum 50 years. Assistant Manager: minimum 21, maximum 40 years. Assistant Grade-2: minimum 18, maximum 37 years, counted on the last date fixed for receiving applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.500 for each application, paid online, and it is not refunded for any reason.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for GTTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on https://gttc.karnataka.gov.in in the prescribed format, then send a printout with copies of documents to the Managing Director, GTTC, Rajajinagar Industrial Estate, Bengaluru-560 010.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay for each GTTC post?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor Rs.107500-167200, Assistant Manager Rs.83700-155200 and Assistant Grade-2 Rs.44425-83700.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for these GTTC posts?
faq.answer: The posts are backlog vacancies reserved for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates, who must be Indian citizens and hold a caste certificate in the government-prescribed format.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application with a separate Rs.500 fee is needed for each post.
